data.content: # Manchester United lineup vs. Facing an injury crisis, Manchester United travels to Italy to take on Como in the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday Oct. 21. That has increased the pressure on manager Michael Carrick, who will be missing nine first-team players for the match at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia. Here is how Manchester United will line up against Como:. ## Manchester United confirmed lineup vs. Manchester United coach Michael Carrick has given Matthijs de Ligt the start at center back, marking the Dutch international's return after nearly a full year out. ## Manchester United injury news vs. ## Will Matthijs de Ligt play vs. With so many injured players, Carrick has given Dutch center back Matthijs de Ligt the start. De Ligt has returned from a long-term back injury and subsequent surgery, making the bench for United's past two games but not seeing the field. "It's great to have him back," Carrick said of De Ligt.
